spec.description: Setup for Brief A4, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data/src, builds spring-context at 4beb25b3 (landed) and 43a86565 (parent), Spring 5.2.1.BUILD-SNAPSHOT, with Gradle 5.6.3 on JDK 8 (Temurin 1.8.0_512). The build reads repo.spring.io/libs-spring-framework-build (anonymous, 200 on 2026-11-22) and lists repo.spring.io/plugins-release after the plugin portal (401 anonymously): a plugin found only there would stop the build, which is itself a setup finding. Jars to .../artifacts with sha256, classpath to .../logs, landed tests rerun --offline, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/spring-and-java-data-setup.md.
